edits.new: | X6 | A role without Platform administration U calls `POST /admin/workflows/smoke` | The call is refused with 403; nothing starts | MSG-P4-002 | AC8 |

Then the merge is blocked

  Scenario: AC8 Role without Platform administration U (X6)
    Given a caller with a role without Platform administration U, such as RW-CASEOWN
    When the caller calls POST /admin/workflows/smoke
    Then the response is 403 with MSG-P4-002
    Then no workflow starts

  Scenario: AC9 Deterministic workflow code (BR2)
    Given the PlatformSmokeWorkflow code is compiled into the worker
    When the build scans the workflow code
    Then no clock, random, I/O, parameter read or direct Drools call appears in the workflow code
    Then time is read through Workflow.currentTimeMillis or a timer

  Scenario: AC10 Task queue per workflow (BR4)
    Given the smoke workflow is started by JOB-22 or by the admin operation
    When the workflow is started
    Then it is placed on task queue `rwb-platform`
    Then no Epic 1 workflow is placed on a service queue

  Scenario: AC11 Worker build ID (BR6)
    Given a worker has no build ID or an unknown build ID
    When the worker is ready to poll
    Then the worker starts no new workflow

  Scenario: AC12 No business table read (BR10)
    Given the smoke workflow runs to completion
    When the run is checked
    Then the smoke workflow reads no recovery_case row, no ACE view and no business table

The admin operation `POST /admin/workflows/smoke` calls the rwb-access authorise check (DP-08) before it starts anything; the check grants the call only to a role holding Platform administration U, which RW-PLATADM holds.
